comparison.objective: Candidate uses a locked lifting pin to transfer and seat a workpiece, then removes the pin; record seats a sleeve while registering a radial oil passage.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate emphasizes button-actuated retention, suspended-load handling, support transfer, and extraction; record emphasizes axial clearance-fit insertion while preserving rotational port alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires pull retention, lift, three-pad seating, and safe withdrawal; record requires released seating plus an unobstructed 10 mm passage during a one-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Both involve insertion and seating, but one tests lifting-hardware retention and recovery while the other tests functional radial registration; no material rubric details are missing.
